sentences.en: He noticed that this drug seemed to inhibit bacterial growth.
sentences.zh: 他注意到，这种药物似乎抑制了细菌的生长。

sentences.en: Some claim that taxing the rich inhibits job creation.
sentences.zh: 有人认为对富人征税会抑制就业增长。

sentences.en: Watching one movie after another inhibits a profound understanding of them.
sentences.zh: 一部接一部地观看电影会妨碍对其深刻理解。

senses.zh: 抑制，阻止；使拘束，使尴尬
